MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF EMPG PRO PERTY HOLDINGS LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON THE 17 TH DAY OF JUNE 2019 
 
 Present 
 Mark Nosworthy Director 
 A a tif Rana Director 
 
 Mark Nosworthy chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 PURCHASE OF SHARES OF ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to purchase ordinary shares of Zameen Developments (Private) Limited (“ Zameen ”) held by EMPG Holdings Limited . The Board unanimously nominated Mark Nosworthy to discuss, negotiate and ac cept this proposal . 
 
 Resolution 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matters in detail, the following resolution was passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company purchase o rdinary shares of Zameen held by EMPG Holdings Limited . 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Mark Nosworthy is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute , on behalf of the Company, all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Mark Nosworthy
